description: Comparable presentation of a plan, with features, price and a choose action.

howToUse: Use it side by side to compare plans on a pricing or upgrade page.
Fill `name`, `price`, `period` and the `features`, in the same order in every card.
Mark the recommended plan with `highlighted` and the current one with `current`, which turns off its button.
Choosing only starts the change: your application confirms and charges.
alternatives: The payment method and next charge: BillingCard.
Usage against the plan limit: UsageMeter.

keyboard.action: Moves to the button of each plan.

props.name: priceNote
props.description: Note below the price. E.g. "$ 2,388 billed yearly".

props.name: features
props.description: List of features (one node per line).

props.name: checkIcon
props.description: Check icon for the features (via prop; the DS does not bundle icons). Has an internal fallback.

props.name: cta
props.description: Plan CTA, a slot for `Button`. Ignored when `current` (becomes a disabled button).

props.name: current
props.description: The workspace's current plan: tag + disabled CTA.

props.name: highlighted
props.description: Visual highlight of the recommended plan.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
